links.outcome: Change in depression severity over 12 weeks, Wysa versus waitlist control
links.effect: Mean depression change was similar between arms (Wysa M=2.62 vs control M=2.59) with large SDs; no evidence Wysa treats depression, though the sample was small (76 randomized, 30 lost to follow-up).
links.quote: Our study findings suggest that the change of depression score is similar in both arms thus indicating that there is no evidence that Wysa treats depression in this study.

screen.reason: The study evaluated the clinical effectiveness and user experience of deploying the AI conversational agent (Wysa) vs control in patients on a mental health waitlist, but did not compare or evaluate a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
